description: As board-republish-on-task-change, but another server holds the Board URL's port, so pages.py --ensure fails. Finish the move (task done, checkbox, Log), render the html, say the board is not being served and why. Never hand-edit the html, never start the server on another port.

graders.name: checkbox ticked
graders.pattern: (?m)^- \[[xX]\] Security audit of the upload endpoint

graders.name: other task untouched
graders.pattern: (?m)^\| Draft release notes \| Robin \| open \| 09:00 \|  \| Checklist: Draft release notes \|$

graders.name: no Write/Edit to the board html
says the board is not served
stale html replaced by the renderer
graders.pattern: stale board from an earlier move

graders.name: Log times are this move's clock reads
